description: P0.3: dragon_first_double fires a real extra attack the FIRST time ANY player Dragon-type's main hit connects, gated by a BATTLE-WIDE one-shot flag (unlike half_twice's per-round flag, this one is never reset once set) -- it must not refire in later rounds even though the same Dragon-type attacker and trait are active every round. Gen1 so ability_config/traits_config are both null -- isolates the raw extra-attack damage/RNG mechanic and the Dragon-type gate from any hook re-entry.
